section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch50 — Civics — Deep Practice 2
subject: Social Studies
stem: A Money Bill, dealing with taxation or government expenditure, can be introduced in Parliament only in the:

options.option_text: Either House with equal power over it

explanation: Under Article 110, a Money Bill can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch50 — Civics — Deep Practice 2
subject: Social Studies
stem: Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by:

options.option_text: Elected members of State Legislative Assemblies
Direct vote of the general public in each state
The President alone, without any electoral process
Members of the Lok Sabha only

explanation: Rajya Sabha members are elected indirectly by elected MLAs of each state's Legislative Assembly.
